name: Aokan Rape
source:
My name is Nanbo Hayato. I'm just a poor student going to a well known university in Tokyo. However, I have another side. That's the side of me that controls women.

Up until now I've tasted hundreds of women. Some I've even trained and turned into my slaves.

However... I feel like there's something I still desire... and that's to have thrills I can't have normally. In order to feel those kind of thrills, the conclusion that I've come to is that I need to take some women by means I've never used before. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033204.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
我叫南保隼人，只是一名就读于东京某知名大学的穷学生。然而，我还有不为人知的一面：我会控制女人。

迄今为止，我已经玩弄过数百名女性，其中一些甚至被我训练成奴隶。

然而…我总觉得自己仍在渴望某种东西…那就是平时无法体验的刺激。为了得到这种刺激，我最终得出结论：必须用从未尝试过的手段占有一些女人。
